title: Upstream 5xx storm opens the upstream breaker while /healthz keeps answering
notes: Load is POST /mcp, a JSON-RPC tools/call of ultrathink_uplift (mcp/mcp.ts UPLIFT_TOOL, routes/router.ts mcpRoute). It is the only HTTP route that starts a headless planner job: POST /ultrathink only queues a run and never reaches the upstream. The completer makes at most three attempts per call (MAX_RETRIES 2, engine/openrouter.ts). The third 503 opens the breaker on the last attempt, so call 1 reports outcome upstream, and calls 2 to 6 are refused by the open breaker and report upstream_unavailable; settle therefore counts requests minus one. Load runs one request at a time so that call 1 is unambiguous. The harness must enable server planning and present the connector key; this template holds no credential.

arguments.prompt: chaos probe: outline a rollout plan

hypotheses.name: The upstream breaker is open after the 503 storm
